mentions.name: Wishlit
mentions.description: A web tool focused on highlighting what is worthy of people's time. It was built as part of experiments in which the author creates tools and monitors what refers traffic to them and how.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building tools and watching what refers to them and how for example: https://www.wishlit.com focuses on what is worthy of people’s time.
